batch: WL42 FNTO validity restoration (post-Batch-6 corrective implementation and re-evaluation)
authorisation: user brief 'ReST-GI - FNTO Validity Restoration, Post-Batch-6 Controlled Implementation & Re-evaluation' (2026-10-23)
contract: docs/FNTO_ARCHITECTURE_CONTRACT_V0_1.md (unchanged); Batch 6 code, protocol fnto_v1, artefacts and worklog 41 are preserved unchanged
audit_source: BATCH6_INDEPENDENT_FNTO_VALIDITY_AUDIT.md (session scratchpad 205cd7bb...; 23 findings); every finding used here was re-measured on the Batch 6 code (results/fnto_lego_r1/audit/, render_checks/)
declared: before the r1 Stage A preprocessing of the training split, before any r1 kernel training and before any r1 evaluation on held-out Lego data. Already measured at declaration and reported as such: Gate 1 (r1 ports), Gate 2a (support reach), relation build and incremental comparison, light calibration, solver detection test, renderer superposition under no clamp (render_checks), Gate 2b quadrature (its file was written 19:08 KST, before this protocol file; its criterion was fixed in r1_gate2_quad.py before the run and is copied here unchanged; result FAIL, see G2b). Process note: r1_gate2_quad.py ran on the PC while the server render chain was running, against the standing no-cross-machine-parallel rule; it reads no rendered data and does not affect the server outputs.

candidate_r1.ports: clusters keyed by (1.2 cm tangential voxel, 3 mm plane bin along the dominant signed axis, material, connected component); origin = medoid surface sample; up to 4 surface samples per port for visibility fractions and gathers (EPS 0.1 mm off a real surface); 852,358 Lego + 1,702 box ports
candidate_r1.pixel_and_hit_identity: pixels and gather hits are attached to ports by surface identity (the hit triangle's cluster key, facing side); Batch 6 used the nearest normal-compatible port
candidate_r1.support: (a0, superseded by amendment 1 = K 96 / 128 near-exact + orientation-stratified area-proportional picks) K_band: all 1.5 cm aggregate sources within the full 5 cm ball, 48 equal-count distance strata, one seeded representative each carrying the stratum area; K_mid: 8 cm aggregate sources within the full 30 cm ball, 64 strata; realised reach median 4.996 cm / 29.99 cm (Batch 6: 1.4 / 5.0 cm)
candidate_r1.kernel_family: fnto_model.DomainKernel unchanged (K_loc 2 GGX + diffuse, K_glob rank 64 (A) / 8 (B), K_band 19 bins, K_mid); linear in radiance, non-negative coefficients
candidate_r1.coupling: dense ray-cast relation table (128 gathers per port, 109.3 M rays) = an explicit diagnostic-grade C; it is NOT compressed and NOT learned (C_phi empty); no efficiency claim follows from it
candidate_r1.solver: Jacobi on per-port incident samples; converged when relative change < 1e-3; DIVERGED when the median of the last 5 successive-residual ratios is >= 1 after iteration 8 or values are non-finite; UNCONVERGED at 100 iterations otherwise; spectral radius of the homogeneous map by power iteration (40 iterations)

stage_a_r1.renderer: r1_stagea_render.py on LabServer63 (bpy 3.5.1 CPU): intrinsic-all paths (free-space hits absorbed; glass internal reflection / TIR kept), max bounces 128, clamp direct 0 / indirect 0, GAUSSIAN 0.01 px point sampling (amendment 2; the first render's 'box 0.01' was a 1 px box), 512^2, 512 spp
stage_a_r1.families: sun x masks 25 %, spot (1-3, cone 5-20 deg half-angle, 4-40 cm from an area-sampled Lego surface point) 35 %, broad (6-20 free-space point lights) 25 %, multisun (2-5 suns, both hemispheres, masks) 15 %; box random (not within 0.25 m of T1) or absent 25 %
stage_a_r1.splits: train 1,000 (seed 1101), holdout 120 (seed 2102, independent configurations of all families). Reduced from Batch 6's 1,400 because each image now carries more independent excitation and the server renders ~16 s per image
stage_a_r1.radiometry: r1_calib: sun S -> E = S; point / spot P -> I = P / (4 pi) W/sr; spot hard cone
stage_a_r1.excluded_from_training: every full-scene image, the T1 geometry, all held-out T0/T1 references

reference_regime_r1: held-out T0/T1 16 views each, same cameras / suns / pixels as worklog 37, rendered on LabServer63: full GI (max_bounces 32 as the generator), NO clamp, GAUSSIAN 0.01 px point sampling (amendment 2), 4096 spp, seed = view (in effect the first view's seed for all views of a set, see amendment 2); and intrinsic-all first-event references (1,024 spp). Historical references (clamp_direct 20 / clamp_indirect 5) stay unchanged and are reported separately; the pixel inputs (position / normal / visibility AOVs) are the historical PC renders (geometry, not compared radiance)
conditional_variant_r1P: ONLY if Gate 4c fails for K_r1 (spectral radius at T0 >= 1): train r1-P = identical run with --passivity 1.0 (hinge on uniform-field effective albedo > 0.98 over 32,768 sampled ports per domain). Both are reported; Gate 5 uses the first kernel that passes Gate 4c; if neither passes, stop at Gate 4 with attribution (no other change)

G1_boundary_state.criteria: r1 origins within 0.2 mm of a surface >= 99 %; first hit along +n an inside face < 1 %; port vs renderer pixel sun-visibility agreement >= 0.97; pooled port/pixel direct irradiance in [0.95, 1.05]
G1_boundary_state.status_at_declaration: measured: 99.998 % PASS; 4.93 % FAIL as declared (4.933 % are surfaces inside ANOTHER component's closed solid = enclosed geometry, 0.002 % same component); agreement 0.962 FAIL as declared (residual: away from shadow edges 6.3 % lit-pixel ports read < 0.5, 2.4 % the reverse; Batch 6 24.7 % / 3.3 %); irradiance ratio 1.001 PASS

G2_intrinsic_and_coverage.b_quadrature: median per-receiver |rel err| <= 0.15 for band (d 1 cm) and mid (d 10 cm) test kernels on the real Lego, T0 view-6 sun
G2_intrinsic_and_coverage.b_status_at_declaration: measured FAIL: band median 0.62 (q90 1.41, pooled ratio 0.99), mid median 0.45 (q90 1.49, pooled ratio 1.34); attribution by r1_gate2_attrib.py (diagnostic) pending
G2_intrinsic_and_coverage.c_coverage: effective rank (99 % energy) of the r1 training incident fields in the 8 cm coarse-port basis reported; the indirect-like field (one Lambertian bounce, albedo 0.5, T0 coupling graph, view-6 sun) has <= 0.10 of its energy outside the span of the training fields (Batch 6: 0.52)
G2_intrinsic_and_coverage.d_kernel_fidelity: held-out r1 probes pooled display PSNR >= 28 dB and K_only vs first-event r1 references (held-out T0, view mean) >= 28 dB; per family and per material reported

G3_reference_consistency.a_linearity: renderer two-sun superposition with no clamp: |signed energy| <= 1 % (measured in render_checks: -0.05 %, PASS; with the historical clamp -8.8 %)
G3_reference_consistency.b_light_table_radiometry: on held-out r1 probes, box pixels (single diffuse material): the red-channel ratio of the render to (1/pi) x reconstructed irradiance has family medians within +-3 % of each other (sun / spot / broad / multisun)

G4_coupling_and_solver.a_incremental: incremental vs full rebuild differ only at equal hit distance (measured: 1,435 entries, all equal distance, 0 share material and component); output effect |view-mean(E_upd) - view-mean(E_relfull)| <= 0.05 dB
G4_coupling_and_solver.c_passivity: spectral radius of the homogeneous composed map at T0 < 1

G5_end_to_end.arms: K_only (coupling off, vs first-event r1), S_T0, D_stale, E_upd, E_relfull; targets hist and r1 labelled separately; historical RNA / Surface-Owned / SPT-1 records unchanged
G5_end_to_end.static: S = view-mean(S_T0 | hist) - 33.569 (RNA_T0, hist): credible >= -1.0, weak [-2, -1), fail < -2.0; S_T0 | r1 reported (no RNA in that regime: RNA was trained on clamped data)
G5_end_to_end.edit_error: F = E_stale / E_upd on A_changed (hist); R_RNA as fnto_v1
G5_end_to_end.edit_signed: on A_changed Lego pixels present in both views: corr(d_pred, d_ref) and LS slope of d_pred on d_ref (hist and r1)
G5_end_to_end.solver: status per view; every view must converge for SUPPORTED

verdict_rules.SUPPORTED: G2d pass AND G3 pass AND G4 pass (incl. 4c with K_r1 or K_r1P) AND every view converged AND S credible AND F >= 1.5 AND R_RNA >= 0.7 AND corr >= 0.5 AND slope in [0.5, 1.5] (hist)
verdict_rules.NOT_SUPPORTED: G4c fails for both K_r1 and K_r1P, OR any view diverges, OR S fail, OR F < 1.1, OR corr < 0.2
verdict_rules.LIMITED: otherwise (the brief: do not force a binary verdict); the report states which K/C property is and is not supported
verdict_rules.G1_note: G1 failed as declared on two criteria, both attributed above to geometry (enclosed surfaces) and port resolution; the verdict text must carry this

do_not_tune: kernel sizes, steps, batch, loss, optimiser
solver tolerance, iteration cap, divergence rule
stop: report and stop at the verdict; no other architecture, no automatic next batch

amendments.when: after the Gate 2b FAIL, before any r1 Stage A preprocessing, kernel training or held-out evaluation
amendments.diagnosis: r1_gate2_attrib.py (synthetic fields: uniform, cos(view-6 sun), cos x 4 cm checker; 4,000 receivers): aggregation (all aggregates vs fine truth) 3-7 % median, uniform-pick bias <= 8 % (mid pooled +5-7 %), single-sample variance 25-40 % = the dominant part. Classified (brief section 4): numerical approximation of the r1 quadrature, not the K/C contract
amendments.correction: band / mid representatives only (r1_reps_a1.py): K/2 nearest aggregates exactly with their own area; the rest ordered by (8 distance shells, dominant normal axis, distance), K/2 equal-count strata, one representative drawn proportional to area carrying the stratum area (unbiased; tests/test_r1_reps_a1.py PASS). Sources, radii, bins and kernel code unchanged
amendments.K_rule: smallest swept K (band 48/96/128/192, mid 64/128/192/256) whose sampling error vs all aggregates on the adverse synthetic field (cos x checker) is <= 0.075 = half the Gate 2b threshold (r1_gate2_ksweep.py: band K 96 -> 0.075, mid K 128 -> 0.049). The declared Gate 2b field (real T0 view-6 sun with shadows) was not used to choose K
amendments.consequences: K_BAND 48 -> 96, K_MID 64 -> 128; anchors_a0.npz kept; training predict runs in 16,384-pixel chunks with activation checkpointing (r1_train --chunk; identical values and gradients; measured peak of the band+mid weights alone at 65,536 pixels: 5.3 GB at a0, 10.6 GB at a1 on the 12.5 GB GPU)
amendments.gate2b_rerun: the declared Gate 2b test (r1_gate2_quad.py, threshold 0.15 unchanged) is re-run on the a1 anchors on the PC after the server render chain finishes; both the a0 FAIL and the a1 result are reported
amendments.gate2b_a1_result: measured 2026-10-24 (gate2/quadrature_a1.json): FAIL - band median 0.27 (q90 1.00, pooled 0.996), mid median 0.20 (q90 0.65, pooled 1.087); synthetic fields after a1 (gate2/quadrature_attrib_a1.json): band 0.05-0.12, mid 0.04-0.08. The q90 of 1.0 = the estimate is 0 for >= 10 % of receivers: the real field is shadow-sparse and far-stratum single picks miss the few lit sources. No further quadrature amendment is made (it would be tuned on the declared test field); Gate 2b is carried as FAIL with this attribution, and descriptive energy-weighted errors are added to the re-run output

amendments.when: after the first server render chain and the holdout preprocessing, before any r1 training or held-out evaluation
amendments.finding: r1_prep dropped 11.2 % of holdout pixels as untraceable; 99.5 % of them lie on depth edges and their AOV positions lie between two surfaces (r1 Stage A cam vectors non-unit on 2-5 % of pixels). r1_filter_check.py (one setting per process): in Cycles 3.5.1 pixel_filter_type BOX ignores filter_width (BOX 0.01 = BOX 1.0 to 1.5e-6 RGB, fractional alpha 0.46 % of pixels for both); GAUSSIAN 0.01 point-samples (fractional alpha 0.012 %). The historical held-out renders are point-sampled (audit #9: binary alpha). So r1 Stage A and the r1 references were 1-px-box filtered, i.e. the #9 / F5 filter correction was not achieved. Also measured: in this bpy build integrator / film settings changed after the first render of a process are not re-synced (a later samples = 1 still rendered 64 / 64) - all production scripts set them before the first render; the per-image / per-view Cycles seed is therefore the first one for every image of a process
amendments.correction: r1_stagea_render.py and r1_refs_render.py: GAUSSIAN 0.01 (all else identical: configurations, seeds, spp, clamps, bounces). Stage A holdout + train and all four r1 reference sets are re-rendered on LabServer63 (r1_render_chain_a2.sh); the 1-px-box outputs are kept as stagea_box1px/ and refs_box1px/ and are not used for training or evaluation. First 5 re-rendered holdout images: fractional alpha 0.3-0.7 % (was 2.3-5.2 %), non-unit cam 0.15-0.4 % (was 2.2-5.0 %). r1_calib (BOX 0.01) is kept: it measures irradiance on flat interior regions where the footprint does not matter
amendments.consequence: r1_prep, Gate 2c and all later steps run on the re-rendered data only
